translations./garage/brief: The east depot mixes gravel with sand. Road tires dig in; wide sand tires are slower but steadier.
translations./prediction/heading: What Limits Motion on Loose Ground?
translations./prediction/hint: Make a prediction. With the wrong tires, time disappears into wheelspin.
translations./prediction/choices/0/text: The tires will hold RO-1 back
translations./prediction/choices/0/feedback: Without enough traction, every step includes slip. Compare odometry error with elapsed time.
translations./prediction/choices/1/text: Energy will exceed the target first
translations./prediction/choices/1/feedback: High rolling resistance keeps the motor working. Read the energy meter.
translations./running/heading: Deliver Supplies to the Signal Tower
translations./debrief/success_summary: Wide sand tires crossed the gravel yard: slower, but every step counted.
translations./debrief/failure_summary: Find which badge was lost. On loose ground, choose traction before chasing speed.
translations./debrief/evidence_caption: Safety, speed, and efficiency are scored separately from this simulation run.
